trades.reasoning: On a strong risk-on day, FLEX has three bullish signals: a MACD crossover, a rising MACD histogram, and an RSI of 59.5 that still leaves room to run, and it trades about 11% above its 20-day average; it also adds some diversification away from our tech-heavy holdings, but without a volume surge it is not a high-conviction buy.

decisions.briefing: Stocks rallied broadly today: the NASDAQ rose 2.4% and the S&P 500 rose 2.1%, a clear risk-on day. The portfolio is up 47.9% overall and our seven positions are holding. Our past lessons say to deploy cash on strong up days, so we are putting the remaining $446 into Flex (FLEX), a contract manufacturer with healthy, not yet overheated momentum. We are skipping very overbought names like SGRY and CNH, and we are holding all current positions so the automatic profit targets and stop-losses can do their job.

market_education.summary_en: Stocks rose sharply across the board today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ up 2.4% and the S&P 500 up 2.1%, a sign that investors were willing to take more risk. The gains were broad, and many semiconductor, hardware, and AI-infrastructure names (AMD, MPWR, ALAB, TTMI) now show bullish momentum signals at the same time. No news headlines were included in today's data, so we can't name a specific cause, but a move this broad usually reflects a change in overall market mood rather than news about one company.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股全面大漲，以科技股為主的納指升2.4%，標普500指數亦升2.1%，反映投資者風險胃納明顯回升。升勢遍及各板塊，半導體、硬件及AI基建相關股份（如AMD、MPWR、ALAB、TTMI）同時出現看漲動能訊號。由於今日資料未附新聞標題，暫未能指出具體催化因素；不過如此廣泛的升勢，通常反映整體市場情緒轉變，而非個別公司的消息所致。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-on' describes a day when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, which pushes major indexes up together. Today the NASDAQ rose 2.4% and the S&P 500 rose 2.1%, a typical risk-on move. Strong days like this are usually a better time to put idle cash to work than flat, uncertain days.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）指投資者信心充足，願意將資金投放於成長股、科技股等較高風險資產，帶動主要指數同步上揚。今日納指升2.4%、標普500升2.1%，正是典型的風險偏好行情。相比方向不明的橫行日子，這類強勢交易日通常是投入閒置資金的較佳時機。
